title: Inspect short European Firaga residual context
changes: Record a 12-frame native API observer and its negative join against the E269 Firaga sample residual.
validation: Wine observer e346-firaga-residual-native-context-wine-hle43zmn passes per-frame state and output comparisons and drains Wine; none of the 66 E302 residual bytes appears in its native API capture.
limitations: This does not exclude later frames, interpreter fallback, host/HLE, direct DMA or other scenes. Exported PCs and dispatch contexts are not exact instruction sites. Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance comparison was made.
